training: Only the existing 10490 TRAIN sentences; no DEV, CALIB, MAIN hard negatives or TEST labels in fitting. Freeze E05 weights; fit a separate partial-label lexical-view residual head.
selection: Select on DEV only: among residual arms with no loss in legacy lemma+POS and declared features against P1, maximize legacy lemma+POS, then projected strict features. If none qualifies retain strength 0. CALIB is run after sealing DEV selection; do not retune on CALIB. Never promote historical default unless both DEV and CALIB satisfy nonregression.
measurements: Single predicted lexical view vs unchanged reference, same measure for all arms
Oracle view coverage separately, never called selected accuracy
Representation-only gain separated from changed native analysis IDs
public_scope: Source code, aggregate reports, protocol and hash receipts only. Raw corpora and weights remain local/on V.
